Common Gaming Houses Act
(Chapter 49, Sections 2(2))
Lotteries
N 1
G.N. No. S 189/1959
REVISED EDITION 1997
(15th June 1997)
[27th November 1959]
The Minister for Home Affairs has declared the games, methods, devices, schemes or competitions set out in the Schedule to be lotteries for the purposes of the Act.

THE SCHEDULE
(a)The “100 characters”, “1,000 characters” or “10,000 characters” game also known as the “100 numbers”, “1,000 numbers” or “10,000 numbers” game also known as the “two-digit”, “three-digit” or “four-digit” game also known as the “two-number”, “three-number” or “four-number” game also known as the Tikam Ekor game or any variation thereof.
(b)The Chap Ji Kee or “12 characters” game.
(c)The Wha Whey or Wah Weh.
(d)The Whei Sang or Wai Seng.
(e)The Chee Fah.
(f)Any distribution of prizes by lot or chance depending on mechanism operated by a spring or any other means.
[G.N. No. S (N.S.) 189/59]
